players.bio: Aliou Dieng is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Spanish La Liga club Valencia CF and the Mali national team. In July 2019, Dieng joined Egyptian club Al Ahly on a five-year contract for an undisclosed fee. On 23 August 2024, Dieng joined Saudi Arabian club Al-Kholood on a one-year loan.
Arnaut Danjuma Groeneveld (born 31 January 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Valencia. Born in Nigeria, he has represented the Netherlands national team.

César Tárrega Requeni (born 26 February 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Valencia CF. Career Tárrega is a youth product of CD Don Bosco, Levante UD and Patacona CF, before finishing his youth training with Valencia CF who he joined in 2019. He was promoted to Valencia Mestalla for the 2021–22 season signing his first professional contract.
Cristian Rivero Sabater (born 21 March 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Valencia CF.
Daniel Raba Antolín (born 29 October 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for La Liga club Valencia.

David Otorbi Ejededawe is a 19-year-old Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Valencia CF in La Liga. Highly regarded for his blistering pace, explosive dribbling, and direct style of play, he is considered one of the brightest young talents to emerge from Valencia's academy (VCF Academy) in recent years.

Diego López Noguerol (born 13 May 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as either a right winger or a forward for La Liga club Valencia CF. Club career Early career Born in Turón, Mieres, Asturias, López began playing football at the youth academy of FC Figueiredo where he scored more than 150 goals, and then Xeitosa CF where he scored 54 goals in his single season with them.

Dimitri Christophe Foulquier (born 23 March 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for La Liga club Granada. Foulquier previously represented the France national under-21 football team, before switching to represent the Guadeloupe national football team.

Filip Ugrinić (born 5 January 1999) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Valencia and the Switzerland national team. Ugrinic is a youth international for Switzerland at the U18 and U19 levels. In October 2019, he was capped at U21 level. Ugrinic is of Serbian descent.

Guido Rodríguez (born 12 April 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for La Liga club Valencia. Rodríguez began his career with River Plate, whom he debuted for in 2014. He stayed with the club until 2016. He struggled for playing time, only managing to appear in sixteen league matches and twice in the Copa Argentina.

Harvey Elliott is a 23-year-old English professional footballer who currently plays as an attacking midfielder for La Liga club Valencia CF, on loan from Premier League giants Liverpool F.C.. Having come up through Fulham's academy, Elliott made his first-team debut in September 2018, becoming the youngest player to play in the EFL Cup, aged 15 years and 174 days
Hugo Duro Perales (born 10 November 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Valencia.

Iker Córdoba Sánchez (born 11 November 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-footed centre-back for Valencia CF in La Liga. Known for his physical presence, standing at 1.90 m (6 ft 3 in), he is highly regarded for his strength in aerial duels and his clean distribution from the back.
Javier "Javi" Guerra Moreno (born 13 May 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for La Liga club Valencia.

Javier Aguirre Onaindía, nicknamed "El Vasco" (The Basque), is a highly prominent Mexican football manager and former player who currently serves as the head coach of La Liga club Valencia CF. Aguirre played for Mexico at the 1986 World Cup, and is currently manager of the team for his third time, coaching them previously on twice occasions, he took them to the World Cup in 2002 and 2010.

Jesús Vázquez Alcalde (born 2 January 2003) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left back for La Liga club Valencia. Vázquez made his first team debut on 16 December 2020, starting in a 4–2 away win against Terrassa FC for the season's Copa del Rey. He scored his first senior goal the following 21 March, netting the B's only goal in a 1–2 loss at CD Alcoyano.
José Manuel Arias Copete (born 10 October 1999) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Valencia CF.

José Luis Gayà Peña (born 25 May 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left back for Valencia CF. An academy graduate of Valencia, he made his senior debut in 2012 and went on to play in more than 75 competitive matches for the club.

Justin de Haas is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for La Liga club Valencia CF. Standing at 1.94 metres (6 ft 4 in) tall, the left-footed defender is known for his physical presence, aerial strength, and ability to build play smoothly out of the defensive line.
Kayne van Oevelen is a 23-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Valencia CF, on loan from Premier League side Ipswich Town F.C..
Luis Jesús Rioja González (born 16 October 1993) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left winger and left back for Valencia CF.

Mouctar Diakhaby (born 19 December 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for La Liga club Valencia. Born in France, he plays for the Guinea national team. Diakhaby was born in Vendôme, France, to Guinean parents. They were from Touba, Boké Region. Diakhaby was born in France, but is of Guinean origin. He is former a youth international for France.
Pablo Carmine Maffeo Becerra (born 12 July 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for La Liga club Valencia, on loan from Super League Greece club Olympiacos.
José Luis García Vayá (born 11 August 1998), commonly known as Pepelu, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Valencia.
Ryūnosuke Satō is a 20-year-old Japanese professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for La Liga club Valencia CF.

Sergi Canós Tenés (born 2 February 1997) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as winger for La Liga club Valencia CF. Canós began his career in the Barcelona Academy and transferred to the Liverpool Academy in 2013.

Stole Dimitrievski (Macedonian: Столе Димитриевски; born 25 December 1993) is a Macedonian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Valencia and the North Macedonia national team. After starting off at Rabotnički in 2010, he has spent most of his career in Spain. Dimitrievski earned 28 caps for Macedonia at youth level, and made his senior international debut in 2015.

Umar Sadiq is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Valencia CF and the Nigeria national team. Sadiq formerly represented the Nigeria national under-23 team and was an important member of the squad that won a bronze medal at the 2016 Summer Olympics.
